limitations: The reference is a listening-audit range, not frame-level truth. Exact speech onsets/offsets are not guaranteed and pauses may fall inside a range. Unannotated regions mean unknown, not non-speech.
Whole-recording DER is prohibited by the source README. Only UEM-restricted scoring over uem/ is defined.

The UEM union coincides exactly with the reference segments (78.542 s both), so there is no reference silence inside the scoring region and false alarm is structurally near zero. A low FA on this data is not evidence of a low false-alarm rate.
102010-230 has a single reference speaker, so its confusion component is structurally zero.

Speaker labels denote identity groups from the audit (H/I/J merged, E/F/K merged). Different labels must not all be read as verified distinct natural persons; only L and M were adjudicated as different people.
Overlapped speech and uncertain multi-party ranges (T/W) were conservatively excluded rather than guessed.
Not suitable as a standalone accuracy benchmark; 78.542 s of reference cannot resolve differences below roughly ten DER points.
provenance.official_release_and_split_equivalence: not applicable; private customer data with no official release
